column4: Setup guide, architecture, demo, write-up and release.

column3: Define agent contracts for Planner, Risk, Reporter and Governance reviewer
column4: Acceptance: One contract per agent: purpose, allowed, not allowed, human decisions, stop conditions. Reviewed against governance/AGENT_CONTRACT_TEMPLATE.md.

column3: Define shared JSON message schema between agents
column4: Acceptance: Schema validated in code; invalid messages rejected with a logged reason.

column3: Extend audit log for multi-agent runs (agent, step, input hash)
column4: Acceptance: Every agent step appends one audit line; log is append-only.

column3: Spike: choose orchestration pattern (coordinator vs peer agents)
column4: Acceptance: One-page decision record with the trade-offs and the pattern chosen.

column3: Parse Jira issue links into a dependency graph
column4: Acceptance: Graph built from 'is blocked by' links in a CSV export; unit tested.

column3: Detect and report dependency cycles
column4: Acceptance: A cyclic synthetic program is flagged with the cycle path.

column3: Compute ready-to-start items and critical path
column4: Acceptance: Ready list and critical path match hand-checked answers on 3 programs.

column3: Unit tests with synthetic programs including a cycle case
column4: Acceptance: Tests run in CI.

column3: Planner baseline: rule-based sequencing
column4: Acceptance: Produces a dependency-respecting order; scored in the eval.

column3: Planner model version proposes a plan from the graph
column4: Acceptance: Model returns the plan as JSON per the shared schema.

column3: Verifier: plan must respect all blocked-by links
column4: Acceptance: A plan that violates a link is rejected and the baseline is used, flagged.

column3: Measure plan validity on synthetic programs
column4: Acceptance: Validity rate for baseline and model published with tag measured.

column3: Risk baseline: overdue, blocked and stale rules
column4: Acceptance: Reuses facts from module 01; scored in the eval.

column3: Risk model reads comments and dependency context
column4: Acceptance: Cites only ticket keys present in the data.

column3: False-alarm and miss rates on labelled cases
column4: Acceptance: Precision, recall and false-alarm rate published with known limits.

column3: Integrate module 01 as the Reporter agent
column4: Acceptance: Reporter runs behind the shared schema.

column3: Reporter uses Planner and Risk outputs
column4: Acceptance: Report shows plan status and risks with cited keys.

column3: Executive brief format with decisions needed
column4: Acceptance: One-page brief; RED items list a decision.

column3: Approval gate: nothing is final without a named approver
column4: Acceptance: Approving with an empty name fails; approval is logged.

column3: Permission check: agents may only call allowed tools
column4: Acceptance: A disallowed tool call is blocked and logged.

column3: Reviewer agent checks outputs against contracts
column4: Acceptance: Contract violations are flagged before a draft is shown.

column3: Map controls to the PMI AI standard and the EU AI Act
column4: Acceptance: Mapping table in governance/ with one control per principle.

column3: Build synthetic program (30+ issues, links, comments)
column4: Acceptance: Fictional program, no real company data.

column3: Label expected plans, risks and RAG
column4: Acceptance: Labels stored as JSON; author-labelled limit stated.

column3: End-to-end eval: single agent vs multi-agent
column4: Acceptance: One command reproduces every published number.

column3: Failure-injection tests (missing data, conflicting instructions, bad link)
column4: Acceptance: Each failure is handled safely and logged.

column3: Write SETUP.md following the setup standard
column4: Acceptance: Steps followed once on a clean machine; untested steps marked.

column3: Architecture diagram and decision log
column4: Acceptance: Diagram matches the code.

column3: Record a 2-minute demo
column4: Acceptance: Shows a run, an approval and the audit log.

column3: Write-up: what worked, what broke
column4: Acceptance: Includes the real eval numbers and known limits.
